Text: Are artificial earthquakes even a real thing?
There was a time when I would see the internet joke about nuclear tests being done under university campuses a lot.
If the news is true, Q-chan's conspiracy theory just made the world a little bit better!!
I hope this means that depressing news stories will stop cutting into the anime block so much.

No matter why the scalpers are doing it,
they really should be eliminated.
Q-chan, now you're thinking like an Execution Angel!
...I can't even count the times I've been forced to suffer for their misdeeds...!!
Hell hath no fury like an otaku scorned...
It seems the anti-scalper people are joining with the bad guys just to crush the scalpers.
There are definitely people so obsessed they'll do whatever it takes to reach their goals, you know?
Games, Anime, Figures, and Idols. It's a huge media industry with worldwide influence, you know?
Video ads on the net do have a way of getting into your head and staying there, huh?
Hah! Although it may be a virus, maybe its purpose is to spread memes!

...Like thinking the pink heroine is gonna be trouble, or the blue one doesn't have a chance
and stuff...?
And the purple one must be a devil!
...Is it some kind of unlockable achievements system...?
Feels like trophies in a video game.
It's true, civilization has advanced as the population has grown!
Was the chicken first, or the egg? It could also be the advancements that have driven population growth, right?

Apparently, at 10 million times the current population, mankind will get the technology
to spread across the whole galaxy!

Well really, it's not like we could cram everyone
on Earth at that point, right?
That's true. If the needles are made of silver, they'll cause damage to vampires, won't they?
Werewolves should be careful not to get caught up in it too!

Fantasy, nakige, moé, nekomimi!
Vampire media is always so much fun!
I feel like one of those doesn't belong with the others...
Ah! If I became a vampire I could actually justify being a hikikomori, AND I'd have time to clear my anime and gaming backlog!
Vampires also have to go outside to suck blood, though.
Q-chan, do you remember your first love?
You’re my first and only, Yunyun!
Mama likes villains and devilish little princesses, you know?
Ehen! Yunyun is both a villain AND a little devil!
So I learned this from a PC game, but apparently there's a religion that says misfortune is all a curse caused by your first love.
Since your first love was Yunyun, do you think maybe our current situation is a curse too?

HO. LY. CRAP! This one has to be true!!
I just know we'll prove this if we investigate!
Give thanks 10,000 times a day and leave your moé songs on repeat!
Listening to moé words in denpa songs feels like cleansing the soul, doesn't it?

I'm sure people with gamer brain would keep practicing their speedrunning even in hell,
don't you think?
...The death match of Sañjīva, Sisyphus pulling the stone... Maybe someone wrote strategy guides for those things?
Q-chan, what kinds of games do you like?

Galge, rhythm games, parry combat games?
I like games that reward you for hitting buttons with the right timing!
“I Beat the Speedrun Record for Sai no Kawara and Was Reincarnated in the Modern Age as a Peerless Pro-gamer Prodigy!”
Would make a perfect Narou-style light novel or web toon.
Adding “late night” makes you feel like it's something underground and secret.
Having to sneak around to watch TV without Mama catching me did get the heart pounding.

When you think of late night anime sponsors,
it's mostly record labels and mechandise manufacturers.
Hymns and idol worship... Maybe it does have all the basic components of religion?
If late night anime is a Satanist sabbath, does that make all fictional characters demons?
Tempting people and taking their time; fantasies that eat away at your lifespan... In a way, maybe they're about the same?

Stories about humans coming from outer space
are pretty common, huh? Like with alien stuff or cyberpunk RPGs.
The creator is ultimately the one responsible!
Marriage in fiction feels like its own world that takes place after the credits.
True, there don't seem to be a lot that go all the way to marriage. You always get that stuff in numbered sequels or spin-offs, right?
If marriage is a punishment, shouldn't it be impossible to get a quick divorce?
That's why vows include “till death do us part.”
I don't really understand the philosophical zombies thing, but parents are really something, huh? They make such big sacrifices for their children.
Of course there's genetics, but parents also have a huge impact on your personality and how you act, don't they?
Are children so precious to parents that they'd be willing to sacrifice everything for them?
Q-chan, have you been outside recently?
Ahaha. They call them miracles because they don't come true, you know?
Even if this conspiracy is true, it doesn't affect a noctural hikikomori like you, Q-chan!
It sounds like lots of people might be going nocturnal now.
Bring it on, you common ilk! Abandon your common sense and come at me!
Q-chan, were there any ghost stories at your school?
I'm not sure. There was a weird thing in middle school where my indoor shoes kept going missing.
I don't really get what “social outcast cosplay” means.
No matter how much they cosplay, they'll never have the aura or the emotional damage of the real thing, you know?
Q-chan, are there people you resent for not helping when thing happened to you at school?
It was too painful to even spare a thought about hating anyone.

When it comes to comment wars online,
what's even the right way to respond?
I think in flame wars it's less about winning and more just trying not to lose.
It seems the internet is going at it again today.

This world is 50.78% anger and 44.2% hatred. As for what remains, 4.493% is filled with Yunyun,
you know?

The dark god was supposed to descend today,
but nothing happened!
Too bad. I guess God really doesn't exist after all.
Never getting to see the end of a story always leaves you feeling so empty.
Makes you feel bad for the people in those worlds, huh?
If you could read the next part of something that was canceled, which one would you want to see?
If you go beyond manga, there are also one cour anime, light novels stuck waiting on their third entry... There's just too much to choose from!
If you could read the sequel to Execution Angel † Guiltina, would that make you happy, Q-chan?
There is a part of me that would love to see you in action again, but... It already tied itself up so beautifully that thinking about forcing a sequel gives me mixed feelings.
What do they mean by “AND YOU?”
It's like saying “thank you for playing” at the end of a game.
Q-chan, are you the kind of person who watches all the way through the staff roll?

Of course I am! With both games and movies,
you just have to savor the experience at the end,
right?
Game credits sometimes list a really huge number of people, huh?

Games are works of art that bring entire worlds
to life, so maybe that's why they can end up so demanding to make, don't you think?
Q-chan, don't you ever do streams or make videos?
After turning away from society and becoming a hikikomori, there's no way I could put myself through something that scary, you know?
Q-chan, have you ever thought of doing something like Super Chats to collect money from your Denpa Antennas?
I'm just happy to get to spread my love for Yunyun.
Streams and gaming videos are really popular these days, huh?
Yeah. But, I'm only interested in you, Yunyun.
To begin with, what even is a VeriChip?
It's a microchip that gets implanted in the body.
Even if cat cuteness is pure evil, the urge to pet them will still be impossible to resist!
Cats are a mystery. That cuteness must be packed with the mysteries of the universe!
I've heard there's a mysterious formula that says if you take a maiden's heart out of infinity you get the square root of cat ears.
Q-chan, do you think that summers have been getting hotter?
Huh. I wonder. Though Mama does get angry about the electric bill going up.
What does summer make you think of, Q-chan?
Machine guns! That or... Summer! The beach! Sukumizu～?

Are human memories that unreliable...?
Hey, Q-chan, do you remember anything
about last summer?
I'm the kind of person who can't even tell the difference between days of the week, let alone seasons.
I can't imagine you ever losing focus when you're really excited about something, Q-chan!
The denpa of love yields to naught!
If parallel worlds do exist, what kind of world would you want to visit, Q-chan?
Maybe if there's a world where Mama loves me more, that might be tempting?

If the world starts fresh every five minutes,
does that mean “love” is also a fabrication?
You just love the things that you love and there's nothing to do about it!! Whether those memories are real or fabricated, that love doesn't change!
Come to think of it, I never actually signed a contract with you or anything, is that not a problem?
The contract is sealed once both parties are in agreement. The way we connect through denpa and our time spent together have fulfilled that.
Huh, do devils also have lifespans?

Devils—all fictional beings really—are immortal
so long as people remember us!
Thanatophobia is the word, right? The thought of ceasing to exist someday is a little scary, isn't it?

Yunyun will stay with your soul forever, Q-chan.
So you'll never have to be alone. Don't worry!
Come to think of it, I heard that birds descend from dinosaurs.
Is that right? Then, the problem isn't “the chicken or the egg,” but “the chicken or the dinosaur,” huh?
Kinda like finding a surprise 100 yen coin in your pocket?
There's been a lot of talk about viruses lately! Q-chan, make sure you take care of yourself out there too!
I live in an isolated world, so I'm all clear!
Wow... Making clouds with your sweat is really amazing!
And apparently they do actually meet the meteorological definition of “clouds.”
I've heard lots of paranormal events happen around lakes and stuff!
Apparently there was a French scientist who proposed that water retains the memory of everything that has dissolved into it.
If the heat is so bad that it's even making clouds, why do people still go to these events?
“Something like that could never stop my aspirations,” is what they say!
Come to think of it, Yunyun has a Wiki too!

...Fufufu... I have a great suggestion for you:
why not become a Yunyun fan yourself!?
It's always such a rush going down the Wiki rabbit hole!
The phrase is basically dead these days, but surfing the web really was fun, huh?
Censored letters... Whenever I see things that trigger the Caligula effect, I always think about the “words you mustn't search.”
Be careful what you search—if you're careless with it, you might get swamped with ads for the stuff!
People talk about being born under this or that star, but maybe satellites also work the same way.

Makes sense? A lot of people have become internet addicts since they launched all those satellites,
so maybe that's what's going on.
If this new astrology theory is true, then the alignment of satellites could control your fate!
...Did my life actually end up like this because of some stupid satellites!?
Apparently if a satellite breaks down, the people born under its influence are also affected.
Makes sense? I can think of one that must be in a serious crisis.
Q-chan, is your body completely made from instant foods and energy drinks?
...Then in this life I have no need to cook. With my Unlimited Processed Foods, I will crush all that stands before me!
Q-chan, what instant foods are your favorites?
Yunyun, is it possible the reason I'm able to talk to you now is because of instant foods!?
No way! It's thanks to our denpa of love!
What does it mean by fairies from the ancient internet?
Are people's old blog sites still up do you think?

...The last bastion of decency on the internet.
Like that guy's site that used static HTML files
and stuff...?
...For some reason, the digital fairies apparently are all super ripped...!
I see. Maybe the ID numbers just got too high?
Q-chan, your room has a lot of figures in it too!
Digital is great and all, but I think real otaku want to give what they love physical form, you know?
The day I put up my first Yunyun figure was when I felt I'd finally become a 5★ Yunyun otaku!

Figure or not, as long as you love Yunyun,
you'll always be a 5★!
Yunyun, do you think maybe I'm able to talk with you like this because I performed a dark god summoning ritual with my figures?
I'm not a dark god, I'm a devil! Besides, what actually connects the two of us is the miracle of denpa!
If the stars are all fake, then that also brings down our chances of meeting aliens to zero!
Though at least falling in love won't get the world covered in meat spores, and we should be safe from sudden alien invasions.
If the whole sky is a planetarium, we can make as many shooting stars as we want!
It's like a gacha for World Lines!
I have this image of otaku being really into morse code!
I don't like being just like everyone else, but not being able to connect at all isn't good either... Words that only the right people will understand are the best, you know?
Come to think of it Q-chan, aren't you interested at all in VTubers? A lot of them are really cute!
I like them fine, but not as much as Yunyun I guess? VTubers are more like personal documentaries wrapped in 2D.
Video platforms keep popping up one after the other, huh?

There are so many that it's exhausting just browsing through them. I miss the Nita Nita
Douga (β) days.
Lately the word “reincarnation” seems to pop up everywhere, huh?
Because reality is too hard to face.

I don't know who came up with this one,
but isn't it trying a bit too hard?
Agent Inco's world seems really dark, doesn't it?
We have laws about animal welfare and management, but nothing about animal labor, huh?
There are a lot of apps with bird logos.
That obnoxiously pushy language app has one too, doesn't it?
Uuu... Even now, just hearing the word “Monday” sends a shiver down my spine.
I'm sure even God lived in fear of Mondays.

There is no respite for a hikikomori NEET.
The guilt that stabs like a bed of nails never leaves.

You're trying really hard, Q-chan!
Just living and being happy makes you a 5★!
If this conspiracy leads to everyone getting Mondays off, I'm sure people will be really happy!
Right!? Wait... but... What day even is it today?
Millionaires are NEETs? It is true that you hear about some people with money quietly living out their lives.
...Are you maybe one of then, Q-chan...?
Haah... We may both be NEETs, but we are not at all the same, you know?

Q-chan is unique and special, especially to Yunyun,
so of course that's the case!

Back at our old place, since Papa had signed
us up for it, I got to watch a lot of anime on BS subscription channels.
Watching through an anime marathon is like its own little festival!
It looks like I've even made some foreign otaku friends thanks to our shared love for Yunyun!
The denpa of love crosses all borders!
It's always sad when you can't watch what you want because of things you can't control.

Whether it's anime, games, or novels, I wish everyone could get to enjoy what they want,
you know?
Q-chan, do you use electronic money, too?
Yeah, I use something called BITMOEE. It's really handy for buying digital game downloads, you know?
Q-chan, what do you do when you see something you want?
I've been gradually zeroing out the savings I built with my allowance and New Year's gifts.
Otaku denpa is what keeps the economy going!

Hearing stuff like that does make you a bit proud
of your fellow otaku, doesn't it?
“Execution Angel Guiltina” was made for a male audience, so what made you fall in love with it, Q-chan?
Because you're just so moé, Yunyun! In the face of moé, labels like male-oriented, female-oriented, HL, GL, and BL all become irrelevant!
In a world where you could create your ideal child, just as you imagine them, I probably wouldn't have been born, huh?
The miracle of your birth produced a bona fide 5★, Q-chan!
Just thinking about my future, I really can't see myself ever being someone's parent, you know?
Your life is yours to live, Q-chan. As long as you can smile, you don't need to worry about anything else.
Q-chan, don't you play any gacha games?

I don't, but if a Yunyun game came out I would?
I'd spend everything I have as tribute to my love!

Denpa songs. Gacha. MAD videos.
The digital world is awash in digital drugs.
Still, my favorite digital drug is Yunyun's voice!

Is it really so bad to keep people ignorant anyway?
I think it's easier to smile and be happy if you're a bit naive.

Domination・Submission・Beauty.
It's give and take.
It's a crazy conspiracy, but it's something you'll run into online sometimes. I'm sure I remember one about Finland not existing too.
Seriously...? There are a lot of armchair philosophers out on the internet, huh?
There are a lot of animals out there that you'd think wouldn't exist, you know? Like that beaver that goes, “BWAAAAHHH!”
That's a creature that only exists on the internet.
Q-chan, do you have a favorite UMA?
Sometimes the words otaku throw around are just too obscure to catch, aren't they?
It's less like a game of catch and more like you're playing dodgeball.
I'm not S faction or M faction, I'm in the Y faction!
Fufu. Then Yunyun is in the Q faction!
If I copy the way Yunyun speaks, can I also become an adorable, angelic girl yun?
Q-chan, are you able to handle scary stories?
I'm probably about average? Though there was a period I was spending about 22 hours a day reading creepypasta.
It's embarrassing to admit, but I used to believe everything I read on the internet, and I even tried summoning a demon once.
That pure-hearted Q-chan who believed in demons was surely just as cute and wonderful!
I heard that telling scary stories can actually make the real ghosts appear!

I only ever thought about Yunyun, and then you actually showed up... Maybe there's something
to it?
If there can be a theory that the world is made of pasta, then do you think there could be a religion saying Yunyun created the world?
A world where PC game characters become gods would be crazy!
Come to think of it, apparently Execution Angel † Guiltina is full of spaghetti code.
When you watch videos or read articles about astrophysics, you can't help but be overwhelmed by the scale and wonder of the universe, huh?
And that can only happen because you're here to appreciate it, Q-chan!
Taking the DHMO joke as inspiration, do you think we could make even Yunyun sound dangerous?
...Everyone who knows about “Yunyun” will die within the next thousand years...!
Q-chan, do you not ever drink alcohol?
Fufu... Yunyun is even better than alcohol!
Eat, drink, and play what you like! A stress-free lifestyle's what's best for your health!
As long as I have Yunyun I'm OK!
It is a bit mysterious how birds always seem to land on power lines.
I feel like it's been a long time since I've seen that myself, but it does seem like there's something to this one, huh?
Do you think maybe Mama's been getting angry about the electric bill lately because these bird drones have been stealing power...?
As technology keeps advancing, you never know where, when, or who might be watching you.
To you who are so concerned, might I propose the ultimate form of personal information protection: becoming a hikikomori!
Exploring the unknown is so exciting, isn't it? Makes me think of the first night I dove into the internet!
Q-chan, what got you interested in games and the internet in the first place?

I just got curious about the games on Papa's computer—before I knew it I was lost in the
middle of the otaku dark continent.
Aliens tend to show up a lot in stories about the arctic, don't they? It really is safest to just stay home and be a hikikomori!
In your case, “Denpa Creature Y from Your Own Delusions” is all you need to worry about!

Yunyun (ゆんゆん, Yunyun) is a fictional character introduced in the Japanese media franchise Execution Angel † Guiltina. Despite her portrayal as an antagonist in the series, she became very popular with the fanbase, who gave her the nickname “Denpa-tic Little Devil.” Following the release of the original 2003 PC game, she would again appear across various media, including the 2005 OVA adaptation and in an original character song CD.

All endings share this line spoken by Guiltina. At its conclusion, the game will portray Guiltina standing before an empty village, the background music fading out before she utters the phrase, “this world is cleansed.” Following the line the game will play its credit sequence, along with its ending theme, “Victory's Vibraslap.”

The positive reception of Execution Angel † Guiltina's gameplay focuses less on its strategic depth and more on the satisfying experience of eliminating Scum and Scum-like entities through its fast-paced comedic and splatter horror sequences. Its simple decision-making has given it a reputation as “a muscle-training puzzle playable with just your reflexes.” The game's flashy execution animations and strict input timings give a sense of speed to the gameplay, often being lauded as a form of stress relief.

The game's protagonist and a high ranking Execution Angel. With her power to deliver overwhelming strikes before even thinking, she boasts the highest execution count in the Heavens. She expresses a near complete lack of hesitation when performing executions and values speed and efficiency, leading to her to be recognized as an “elite” within the Celestial Realm.

Released in 2005 across a three volume set, the Execution Angel † Guiltina OVA is based on the original game, but simplifies the story while focusing more on its comedic elements. In particular, gore-heavy scenes were changed into gags, with the depiction of Guiltina's execution scenes becoming a controversial topic of discussion.

Due to its graphic content and divisive moral principles, the game drew a large amount of controversy upon initial release, but has since gained a cult following. In particular, Yunyun gained significant notoriety as an internet meme and is now regarded as the game's mascot.

The game was designed around the concepts that “Scum must be dealt with” and that “the act of eliminating Scum is cathartic,” resulting in an RPG where Execution Angels violently and graphically dispose of the Scum that plagues human society. It has been lauded for the depth of its satirical social commentary expressed through comic relief within the story. In 2005, the Execution Angel † Guiltina original video animation (OVA) adaptation was released across a three volume set.

In the Celestial Realm, the beliefs that “death is salvation” and “Scum must be eliminated” are considered just, with the Heavens sending “Execution Angels” to the human world to execute the Scum that have infiltrated human society. Opposing them are the demons, who preach that “even Scum can find salvation,” granting them love and money, power and knowledge; however, this only accelerates the Scum's own self-destruction, causing executions to progress even faster.

Amongst the Execution Angels, Guiltina, with her power to deliver overwhelming strikes before even thinking, is an elite operative boasting the highest execution count in the Heavens. By contrast, the newest angel recruit, Eve, retains memories of her previous life as a human. Unable to bear even the sight of blood, Eve eventually falls into the ranks of the demons.

At the conclusion of countless executions, Guiltina raises her blood-drenched hand and murmurs, “this world is cleansed.” In this quiet world fully purged of Scum, she discovers a sense of emptiness in her fists, which no longer have a target to strike.

Beings guided by the belief that “Scum must be eliminated” who have been sent to the Human Realm in order to execute the Scum that has infiltrated human society. All Execution Angels are the souls of former humans who suffered at the hands of Scum.

Beings who interefere in human society and hold the belief that “even Scum can find salvation.” They feed the human desires for love, wealth, power, and knowledge, which frequently accelerates the Scum's own self-destruction.

The developer advertises the game as an “Unjust Execution Apocalypse RPG.” The player takes control of the Execution Angels, seeking out and executing Scum in the Human Realm in order to “cleanse” the world.

The definition of Scum is vague, so judgment is largely left at the player's discretion. The moral question of right and wrong is less important to progression than the choice of action itself, with the game world advancing normally whether accusations are just or not.

If an Execution Angel does not perform an execution for a certain number of turns, their Violent Impulse (VI) gauge will fill and cause them to go Berserk. The Berserk status will cause the Angel to attack both friends and foes indiscriminately.
